text:
maria: morning async — quick blitz before meeting. did: ran weekly infra audit (staging). found 2 findings: (1) staging KMS key 'redwood-stg-customer' shows missing rotate permissions for ops-bot; (2) an older IAM role attached to eks-nodepool still has broad s3:List permissions.
linus: thanks. can you paste the scan IDs?
maria: scan ids: S-20260317-447 and S-20260317-448. added short notes in the ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3782
ajohnson: pinging for a quick PR review — iam role cleanup is in https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1294, small and safe. could use an approval before I run terraform plan.
tasha: I'm on rotation for KMS today, happy to help with the rotate flow. maria, can ops-bot get kms:Update* on that key? we tried a dry-run and hit AccessDenied.
maria: exact error snippet:
```
Error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ops-bot is not authorized to perform: kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
kyler: for the iam role, I proposed least-priv changes: remove s3:List from nodepool role, add specific bucket read permissions. I put the terraform diff in the PR description.
sec-bot: auto-scan finished for S-20260317-448 — severity: medium, remediation: update IAM policy. Details: https://scans.redwood.internal/scan/S-20260317-448
linus: plan — tasha to grant ops-bot temporary kms:update perms via a short-lived role; maria to attach the role and test; ajohnson to re-run terraform after PR merged; kyler to prep the roll-back plan in case a pod starts failing.
maria: blockers: waiting on short-lived role from security (tasha). also need a quick ✅ on PR from @ajohnson.
ajohnson: I can take a look now, expecting to merge in ~30m if no runtime surprises.
tasha: granting temp role — creating role 'ops-kms-rotator-temp' with expiry in 2h. will post ARN here when done.
sec-bot: note: scheduled midnight compliance sweep will re-run these checks — recommend we resolve before 03:00 UTC.
kyler: thanks all — I'll watch for the PR merge and put a rollback play in SRE runbook.
maria: thanks — will update the ticket and mark as 'in progress'. ping if anything blocks.
linus: :thumbsup:
